coastVisual.meaning: Blue mineral sea, shallow-water color bands, sparse shoreline foam and static offshore wave marks. No lower forest.

continuousCoastRepair.colorMethod: One shared vertex color per position, smooth distance-to-unified-coast falloff, embedded sparse surf; zero alpha overlay and no new texture.
continuousCoastRepair.performanceLimit: Serialized asset costs measured; cloud WebGL is disabled, so real browser FPS and total memory not measured.

tangentShoreRepair.method: Keep the complete rounded neck component, without cutting the fillet to a fixed corridor. Replace main/landing/neck walls with one joined exterior. All original course land tops and navigation remain unchanged.

legacyFloatingRockCleanup.rule: Only complete closed ico pebble components intersecting crater; exact LayerRock0 12V/30E/20 triangular F, bbox<2.6, base above regionHeight-0.6. Never clip faces or remove strata.

colorAudit.method: Every pair, including all actual regional links and any visually neighbouring pair, uses a distinct base ground colour with CIE76 deltaE >=20. Within each region, correlated vertex-color variation and real relief remain.

streetScene.details: Six distinct module ground colours with exported vertex-colour variation, true excavated craters and raised layered hills, asymmetric broad-leaf plants, fossil ribs and spines, opaque faceted crystals and weathered rocks. Five actual station shell silhouettes. Only declared region ground meshes and four listed station shell parts per lesson are replaced; roads, course identifiers, navigation, positions and entry steps retained.
